App.Title: URL Shortener
Hero.Subtitle: Paste a link, pick a service and get a tidy short link with a QR code.
Input.LooksShort: This already looks like a short link.
Service.Label: SERVICE
Service.is.gd: Free, no account, running since 2009. Supports custom aliases.
Service.tinyurl: The oldest shortener (2002). Free, no account. Supports custom aliases.
Service.da.gd: Open-source and minimal. Aliases up to 10 characters.
Service.v.gd: is.gd's sister service: shows a preview page before redirecting.
Alias.Characters: Use only letters, numbers and _ in the alias.
Alias.CharactersDash: Use only letters, numbers, - and _ in the alias.
Url.Invalid: That doesn't look like a valid link.
Url.Scheme: Only http:// and https:// links work.
Url.LocalAddress: Local and private network addresses can't be used with a public service.
Url.NoDomain: The address needs a full domain name, like example.com.
